name: oishefarhan.com
description: Root build entrypoint. `npm run build` produces sites/quartz/public, which wrangler deploys as a Workers static-assets site.

scripts.build:widgets: npm --prefix packages/explorables ci && npm --prefix packages/explorables run build
scripts.build:site: npm --prefix sites/quartz ci && npm --prefix sites/quartz run install-plugins && npm --prefix sites/quartz exec -- quartz build -d ../../vault -o public
scripts.build: npm run build:widgets && npm run build:site
